title.hi: मूल ढांचा: उदाहरण हैं, सूची नहीं

sources.name: Kesavananda Bharati v State of Kerala, 24 April 1973 (Indian Kanoon)
sources.what: Thirteen-judge bench; writ petition of 1970; Beg J: bench larger than any previous bench; Shelat and Grover JJ list of basic elements and 'These cannot be catalogued but can only be illustrated'

sources.name: Supreme Court Advocates-on-Record Association v Union of India, 16 October 2015 (Indian Kanoon)
sources.what: 99th Amendment 2014 and NJAC Act tested against independence of judiciary and basic structure; quotes Minerva Mills (Chandrachud CJ: limited amending power cannot be enlarged into absolute power; Article 368(5) void); 39th Amendment 1975 and Article 329A on the Prime Minister's election

sources.name: Dr Balram Singh v Union of India, 25 November 2024, 2024 INSC 893 (Indian Kanoon)
sources.what: Challenge to 'socialist' and 'secular' (and 'integrity') added to Preamble by 42nd Amendment 1976 dismissed; amending power extends to Preamble; amendments can be challenged for basic structure violation

q.en: In which case did the Supreme Court first hold that the amending power cannot destroy the basic structure?
q.hi: किस मामले में सर्वोच्च न्यायालय ने पहली बार कहा कि संशोधन की शक्ति मूल ढांचे को नष्ट नहीं कर सकती?

why.en: Kesavananda Bharati, 1973. Golaknath came earlier with a different rule; Minerva Mills built on it later.
why.hi: केशवानंद भारती, 1973। गोलकनाथ पहले एक अलग नियम के साथ आया था; मिनर्वा मिल्स ने बाद में इसे आगे बढ़ाया।

q.en: In the NJAC case of 2015, which amendment was struck down?
q.hi: 2015 के राष्ट्रीय न्यायिक नियुक्ति आयोग मामले में कौन सा संशोधन रद्द हुआ?

why.en: The 99th Amendment of 2014; the Court held it impinged on the independence of the judiciary.
why.hi: 2014 का निन्यानवेवाँ संशोधन; अदालत ने माना कि यह न्यायपालिका की स्वतंत्रता पर असर डालता है।

q.en: What did Minerva Mills, 1980, add to the doctrine?
q.hi: 1980 के मिनर्वा मिल्स मामले ने इस सिद्धांत में क्या जोड़ा?

en: Fundamental rights can never be amended
A limited amending power is itself a basic feature
hi: मौलिक अधिकारों का कभी संशोधन नहीं हो सकता
सीमित संशोधन शक्ति अपने आप में मूल विशेषता है
प्रस्तावना का संशोधन नहीं हो सकता

why.en: That is why clauses 4 and 5 of Article 368 were struck down.
why.hi: इसी कारण अनुच्छेद 368 के खंड 4 और 5 रद्द हुए।

factsToCheck: Minerva Mills (31 July 1980) was not opened directly today; its holding is taken from the passage quoted in the NJAC judgment (2015), and the year 1980 from general record
Golaknath's holding (fundamental rights cannot be amended) is stated briefly from the standard record, not from a page opened today
notes: Teaches the legitimacy of the basic structure doctrine as contested (critics: not in the text, open-ended, judges over a special majority; supporters: guard for a limited amending power), naming no party or person. Recall tests only settled holdings. Kept to the doctrine itself; Article 368 procedure is left to the amendments line. Past question: Prelims 2019 Q45 (answer: 2 only); the script explains the 39th versus 44th Amendment swap. Recent example: Balram Singh, 25 November 2024.
